notes:
Sync stops getting silently stuck, and now tells you the truth about where it stands — on every device. If your session ends, you sign back in right where you are without losing a thing.

**New**

- **You can always tell whether you're synced.** A clear, honest sync status now shows up across iOS, desktop, and Android — synced, syncing, offline, or "sign in needed" — with an at-a-glance indicator you can see without opening Settings, and a quiet alert if a background sync fails. No more guessing whether your notes made it. (PRD Addendum 25 §W7/§W8/§W9/§W10.)
- **Signing in on a new device shows a real "Downloading your notes…" progress.** The first sync now reports how far along your initial download is, instead of sitting on an ambiguous "Connecting…". (PRD Addendum 25 §W11.)

**Fixes & polish**

- **Sync can no longer get silently stuck.** If your session ends — it expired, or this device was signed out from somewhere else — the app now says so plainly and lets you **sign back in right where you are, without losing anything.** Any notes you'd written in the meantime are kept and pushed the moment you reconnect. (PRD Addendum 25 §W1/§W3.)
- **A removed device now says so honestly.** A device that was signed out elsewhere used to show a confusing error; it now reports its status clearly and points you to signing back in. (PRD Addendum 25 §W9.)

**Under the hood**

- **Sessions now use a sliding-window TTL** — they stay alive as long as you keep using the app, instead of expiring on a fixed timer and dropping you mid-use. (PRD Addendum 25 §W2; ADR-0019.)
- **Your device identity persists across reinstalls**, so reinstalling no longer spawns a duplicate device in your account, and a **revoked device can't quietly reinstate itself**. (PRD Addendum 25 §W6/§W1.4; postmortem 0009.)
